debug.description: Enable debug-level logging for detailed troubleshooting.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Recommended: INFO for production, WARNING or ERROR for high-volume systems.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the Heat engine log file. Set to empty string to disable file logging.

rootwrap_config.description: Path to rootwrap configuration file used for privilege escalation.

workers.description: Number of concurrent worker processes. Set to 0 for single-process mode (development only).

transport_url.description: Message broker connection URL. Use `redis://` for Redis or other backends.

connection.description: Database connection string. Supports MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite (not recommended for production).

auth_uri.description: Public Identity API endpoint (v3). Used for user-facing authentication.

auth_url.description: Internal Identity API endpoint (v3). Used for administrative operations.

auth_type.description: Authentication method for Heat service credentials. Typically 'password'.

project_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service project (OpenStack default: Default).

project_name.description: Project name where Heat service account resides.

user_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service user.

username.description: Username of the Heat service account in keystone.

password.description: Password for the Heat service account.

trusts_delegated.description: Enable trust delegation for nested stacks (requires trustee support).

stack_user_domain_name.description: Domain name used to isolate stack users (must be unique per deployment).

stack_user_domain_id.description: Optional UUID of the stack user domain. Leave empty to auto-resolve from domain name.

heat_api_uri.description: Heat API endpoint used for stack notifications (e.g., scaling events).

ssl_ca_file.description: CA certificate bundle for verifying SSL/TLS connections. Empty = system default.

ssl_key_file.description: Client private key file for mTLS (optional).

verify_ssl_for_instances.description: Enforce SSL verification when Heat communicates with instance metadata endpoints.

rpc_response_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for synchronous RPC responses before timing out.

stack_operation_timeout.description: Maximum duration (seconds) allowed for a stack operation before it is marked as FAILED.

enable_stack_adopt.description: Enable stack adopt functionality (recreates stack from existing resources).

enable_stack_rollback.description: Enable automatic rollback when stack creation/update fails.

enable_stack_abandon.description: Enable stack abandon functionality (detach from resources).

max_resources_per_stack.description: Maximum number of resources allowed per stack (prevents resource exhaustion).

max_nested_stack_depth.description: Maximum depth of nested stacks allowed (prevents infinite recursion).

region_name.description: Default region for service endpoints. Required in multi-region deployments.

convergence_engine.description: Enable the newer convergence engine (recommended for production).

db_idle_timeout.description: Seconds before idle database connections are closed (MySQL/PostgreSQL).

db_min_pool_size.description: Minimum number of connections kept open in the database connection pool.

db_max_overflow.description: Maximum number of additional connections beyond min_pool_size.

notifications_storage_enabled.description: Persist notifications to database (required for Heat dashboard events).

trustee_client.description: Service name registered in keystone for trustee delegation (usually 'heat').

clients_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for client calls to other OpenStack services (Nova, Neutron, etc.).

items.description: Hostname or URL pattern to skip SSL verification for (e.g., internal IPs)

skip_ssl_verify_endpoints.description: List of endpoints where SSL certificate verification should be disabled (for lab/testing environments).
